title: ShardMemo: Scope-Before-Routing for Agentic Memory Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2601.21545v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic systems accumulate persistent memory across sessions, tools, and tasks, and a later request must retrieve from it under two distinct constraints: which memories it is permitted to access, and which are relevant under a limited search budget. Existing memory systems handle access scope in two flawed ways: applying scope after retrieval wastes probe budget on inadmissible memories, while treating scope as a learned ranking feature makes a hard constraint depend on router quality. We present SHARD-MEMO, an agentic memory system built on scope-before-routing: metadata predicates first identify the admissible shards, and a learned router then selects a small number of them for shard-local approximate nearest neighbor retrieval. Given the supplied scope predicate and metadata, this separates hard admissibility from learned relevance ranking, so inadmissible shards cannot consume shard-probe budget. translated_title: ShardMemo：面向智能体记忆检索的“先范围后路由”方法
translated_abstract: 智能体系统会在会话、工具和任务之间积累持久记忆，后续请求必须在两种不同的约束下从中检索：允许访问哪些记忆，以及在有限搜索预算下哪些记忆是相关的。现有记忆系统以两种有缺陷的方式处理访问范围：在检索之后再应用范围，会在不可访问的记忆上浪费探测预算；而将范围视为可学习的排序特征，则使硬性约束依赖于路由器的质量。我们提出SHARD-MEMO，一个基于“先范围后路由”原则构建的智能体记忆系统：元数据谓词首先确定可访问的分片，随后由学习到的路由器从中选取少量分片进行分片局部的近似最近邻检索。在给定范围谓词和元数据的前提下，该方法将硬性可访问性约束与学习到的相关性排序相分离，使不可访问的分片无法消耗分片探测预算。我们在LoCoMo、HotpotQA等数据集上进行了评估。
tldr: 提出ShardMemo智能体记忆系统，通过“先范围后路由”机制先用元数据谓词筛选出可访问的记忆分片、再由学习到的路由器选取少量分片进行局部近似最近邻检索，从而将硬性访问约束与学习相关性排序分离，避免不可访问分片浪费探测预算。
en_tdlr: ShardMemo is an agentic memory system built on scope-before-routing, where metadata predicates first identify admissible shards and a learned router then selects a few for shard-local approximate nearest neighbor retrieval, separating hard admissibility from learned relevance ranking so that inadmissible shards never consume probe budget.
